title: Signature
description: Structured cryptographic signature binding object type, stable identifier, canonical payload hash, issuer identity, and issuance timestamp. Required fields per AGP Implementation Profile §5.2.

kid.description: Key identifier for the signing key

issuer.description: Identity of the issuer who signed this object

issued_at.description: Timestamp at which this signature was created

payload_hash.description: Hash of the canonical JSON serialization of the signed payload (alg:base64url)
